g.text: Unrecovered native double precision · direction + Lorentz transformation
All N=100 observations; resolution 1%. Hollow triangles: zero events, one-sided 95% upper reference 2.95%.
Ninja-zero tail ratios are undefined/unbounded gaps; no epsilon or smoothing.
Self-consistency estimates do not measure error against a finite-part oracle.
